title: Business Analyst
text: Business Analyst at DC Strategy (Melbourne, CBD & Inner Suburbs; Full Time; salary: not stated). We are the only multi-disciplinary firm in the franchise sector. From our commercial consultants, to our specialist lawyers to our lead generation and recruitment team, we find the most effective ways to grow sustainable franchise businesses in Australia and around the world. We are DC STRATEGY! The Person We're looking for an experienced BUSINESS ANALYST bursting with purpose and dedication to join us full time in our Melbourne office. You probably have a commerce or similar degree and have gained expertise in Franchising or Business Consulting and may have worked in the Service, Retail or QSR. You'll need to be proficient in the following: Excellent analytical skills Experience in financial modelling Proficiency in Microsoft Excel Market research ability. You're organised, a clear thinker and a good communicator who's as comfortable taking direction as taking initiative. You’re self-directed, resourceful and accountable to a team; you’re hungry to grow and learn and willing to seize this break and own the role. The Business Mission Some of the core fundamentals we look for: A genuine alignment with our values The horsepower to process information quickly with keen attention to detail The aptitude to learn quickly and extrapolate appropriately The ability and will to make things happen – you know how to set goals and work hard An understanding of how technology is enabling networked business models The readiness to work at all levels in a flexible organization model - we believe in working circles rather than hierarchy. A commitment to hold oneself accountable to self, to team and to clients. Who we are For 35 years our team of dedicated, talented professionals have grown networks and brands across Australia and the world. A smaller specialist organisation with a vibrant, supportive culture we work together across several disciplines in an end-to-end firm that continues to dominate the franchise development space. And now DC Strategy is searching for more exceptional, can-do people to join us in an exciting growth trajectory. Apply Now! If this position description excites and challenges you to excel, we want to hear from you. Send your resume addressing the skills and qualifications relevant to the position to: jacqueline.hopley@dcstrategy.com or call 02 8220 8720 to set up a meeting.
